context:
Result-model alignment first, then runner extraction. Reverse order
fails because the runner can't be shared until the result type is
unified.

For w1, walk both result dataclasses field-by-field; for each field,
classify as (shared / TPC-H-only / TPC-DS-only). Shared fields land on
the base ThroughputResult; spec-specific fields stay on subclasses.
This is the documented approach in R-06.

Extract runner only after w2 lands and is verified - the runner
signature is `StreamRunner.run(...) -> ThroughputResult`, which
presumes the unified type exists.

Sequence migrations one spec at a time. Don't bundle.
description:
Quality plan supplement - duplication workstream follow-up. Tracks
residual R-06 from
`quality-consolidate-duplicate-code-clusters` (see
docs/development/duplication-residuals.md).

TPC-DS and TPC-H ship near-identical throughput-test harnesses: shared
concurrent-stream executor + metrics calculation + smaller exception +
connection-close blocks (~77 lines of duplication). The dedup TODO
deliberately deferred this because clean extraction needs:
  - Aligning `TPCHThroughputTestResult` and `TPCDSThroughputTestResult`
    shapes (near-identical fields with different spec-naming comments)
  - Unifying success-rate gates (TPC-H uses configurable
    `config.min_success_rate`; TPC-DS hard-codes 70%)
  - Introducing a shared `StreamRunner` protocol

This TODO does the alignment and extraction. Result is a
`core.throughput.runner` module that both benchmarks consume; spec-
specific success criteria stay surfaced via config, not buried in
per-benchmark forks.

anti_patterns.dont: collapse spec-specific result fields into the base type
anti_patterns.instead: base for shared, subclass for spec-specific
anti_patterns.why: that loses spec naming the reports rely on

anti_patterns.dont: introduce abstraction beyond what the two specs share
anti_patterns.instead: the StreamRunner protocol covers two callers, not N

anti_patterns.dont: migrate both specs in one commit
anti_patterns.why: the bundle risk is exactly why R-06 was deferred from the parent TODO

anti_patterns.dont: silently weaken the TPC-DS 70% success-rate gate
anti_patterns.instead: keep 70% as the default, only make it config-overridable

preserves.behavior: All TPC-H + TPC-DS throughput tests pass at scale 0.01 on DuckDB
Concurrent-stream count semantics unchanged for both specs
TPC-DS throughput test 70% success-rate gate - must remain the default; only become overridable, not weaker
TPC-H configurable min_success_rate behavior - same config knob, same default
TPC-H throughput test result shapes - public field names unchanged on the result surface that report templates and visualizations consume

verifications.command: uv run --with pylint --with pandas --with polars pylint --disable=all --enable=duplicate-code --min-similarity-lines=15 benchbox/core/tpch/throughput_test.py benchbox/core/tpcds/throughput_test.py 2>&1 | grep -c 'R0801'
verifications.description: Pylint R-06 cluster (~77 lines) drops out

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/tpch/ -q -k throughput
uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/tpcds/ -q -k throughput
uv run benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpcds --scale 0.01 --phases throughput --dry-run /tmp/preview
verifications.description: TPC-DS throughput dry run on DuckDB

work_units.summary: Diff TPCHThroughputTestResult ↔ TPCDSThroughputTestResult; map each field to unified ThroughputResult or per-spec subclass. Output: docs/development/throughput-result-alignment.md.
Introduce benchbox/core/throughput/result.py with the unified ThroughputResult dataclass. TPC-H and TPC-DS specific fields land on a thin per-spec subclass. No callers migrated yet.
Introduce benchbox/core/throughput/runner.py with StreamRunner protocol, concurrent-stream executor, metrics calc. Success-rate via config (TPC-DS default 70%, overridable). One commit.
Migrate TPC-H throughput_test.py to use core.throughput.runner.StreamRunner; preserve config.min_success_rate behavior. One commit.
Migrate TPC-DS throughput_test.py to use core.throughput.runner.StreamRunner; preserve hard-coded 70% gate as the config default. One commit.
Re-run pylint duplicate-code at 15-line threshold over both throughput modules; confirm R-06 cluster drops out. Update docs/development/duplication-residuals.md.
